modulePeakOverrides.description: Independent authored private-call budget; persistent and boundary/shared objects excluded
Independent authored private-call budget; persistent and boundary/shared objects excluded

assumptions: Private module budgets are reserved for the complete actual call span. Persistent, boundary and cross-module canonical allocations remain unchanged. The opaque private budget is classified as reserve; it is not a measured category breakdown.
Independent authored private-call budget; persistent and boundary/shared objects excluded
Independent authored private-call budget; persistent and boundary/shared objects excluded
Group totals sum explicitly evaluated physical work and traffic. Replicated local useful work is not the logical model numerator for MFU.
Logical compute is evaluated once from the expanded graph and kept in model_useful scopes separately from physical group_total costs.
Node seconds use the slowest participating device. Model seconds use the declared serial-barrier makespan, including named communications; device seconds are never summed as wall time.
Modules aggregate their declared expanded graph leaves, including graph-native communications. Plan-level communications belong to the model; they are not implicitly assigned to a module.
Unplaced or incomplete local equations remain unknown. Network-only communication does not imply zero HBM, local reduction or staging cost.
Logical nodes start all participating devices together; successors on any shared device stream wait for the node barrier. Independent streams may overlap.
Assignments resolve stable leaf/container scopes; unspecified nodes use $default on their actual devices. Stream identity is (physical device, streamId), independent of group aliases.
Read/write and scratch alias hazards retain expanded mathematical order on each physical device. Disjoint regions are not inferred from a shared backing.
ideal ignores resource contention. user_efficiency uniformly scales the progress of every device interval, including fixed and communication time.

shared_bandwidth models only declared compute HBM demand: bytes/isolatedSeconds. On a device all active compute intervals progress at min(1, peakHBM/sumDemand). Network-only events keep their declared isolated transfer model; local staging/reduction and link contention are not inferred.
No cross-call overlap, implicit communication or real-hardware trace claim. Missing times/resources leave absolute stream timing and temporal memory unavailable.
